note: Example data: an invented family dental practice with invented accounts, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input. The call log, Clarity export, practice management counts, owners and quotes are what the user pasted; the rest has the shape the InsightfulPipe MCP returns.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "customer-journey-map" skill. Map how new patients find us and book, from first hearing of us to coming back and leaving a review, and tell me the five touchpoints to fix first. Our booking page used to convert about 30% of visits before we changed the booking widget in August.

business.name: Example Family Dental
business.what_it_sells: family dentistry: checkups, cleanings, fillings, emergency visits and Invisalign

journey.customer: new patients looking for a family dentist

owners.website and booking page: Office manager (the website vendor makes changes)

quotes.source: new patient form, 'how did you hear about us'
quotes.text: My old dentist retired and a neighbour mentioned you.
I googled why my tooth hurt at night and your article came up.
I just wanted to know if you take my insurance before I called.
I tried booking on my phone and the calendar kept jumping back to today.
Called at lunch twice and nobody picked up.

team_touchpoints.touchpoint: Word of mouth from existing patients
Confirmation text the day before the visit
Rebooking at checkout, before the patient leaves

team_views.Comes back: Busy, means to rebook and forgets
team_views.Recommends: Happy, but nobody asks for a review

pages.note: rage clicks on the date picker, mostly on mobile
dead clicks on the insurance logos, which are not links

rows.query: how much does a filling cost
why does my tooth hurt when i bite
how long does a crown last
how often should you get a cleaning

groupings.flow_message_name: Recall 2: we saved you a time
